title: Anthropic signs $19B data-center lease with TeraWulf
summary: Anthropic signed a long-term lease with nuclear- and hydro-powered operator TeraWulf, adding to over 1 GW of US capacity ahead of its planned IPO.

title: CNBC: Chinese models now handle 30-46% of US enterprise gateway tokens
summary: CNBC reported cheap Chinese open models have held over 30% of weekly OpenRouter token traffic since February, peaking at 46%, as firms like Lindy switch from US models to cut costs.
reason: Open Chinese models eroding US lab dominance in usage.

title: UN AI for Good Global Summit opens in Geneva; new Global Commission launched
summary: The ITU's AI for Good summit ran July 7-10 in Geneva; the UN and ITU also launched an AI for Good Global Commission co-chaired by Marc Benioff and Paul Kagame on sharing AI gains with developing nations.

title: Prince George's County extends pause on hyperscale data centers after protests
summary: Following a July 1 rally demanding a ban, Maryland's Prince George's County Council approved a two-year moratorium on new hyperscale data-center development.
reason: Local moratorium driven by protests. Vote date inferred from Jul 8 reports.

title: Meta's Muse image generator criticised for using others' public Instagram photos
summary: Meta launched its first in-house image model across its apps, drawing privacy criticism over a feature that can draw on other users' public Instagram photos.
reason: Platform-scale use of personal images; minor.
